name: Sbu Inventory

replaces.name: Sortly: Inventory Simplified
replaces.price_model: free download capped at 100 items, then monthly or annual subscription (reviews quote $4.99-49.99/month, $299-2,700/year after repeated price hikes)

one_thing: Keeps everything you own in one place, with photo, where it is and how many, and closes on one figure: how many things you have.

features.name: Items with photos
features.description: Name, up to 8 photos (camera or PhotosPicker, no library permission), quantity, notes; photos downscaled to 2048 px HEIC with EXIF orientation applied, thumbnails cached.
features.reason: Sortly's core card: 'Item photos'. Orientation fixed at import: 'orientation of pictures is not quite good' (3 reviews), 'photos have to be snapped from within app'.

features.name: Places and folders
features.description: Nested folders for locations and containers (Casa > Garage > Scatola 3), any depth; move items or folders by drag, swipe or 'Sposta in'; breadcrumb path on every item.
features.reason: Sortly's 'Custom folders' is the organizing model; Boxes builds the whole app on containers.

features.name: Quantities
features.description: Integer quantity per item with a stepper and direct entry; folder rows show item count and total quantity of everything inside.
features.reason: Sortly's '+/-' on every item; 'Random quantity jumps' review: a stepper that only changes on tap, no gesture side effects.

features.name: Search
features.description: One search field over name, notes, tags and custom field values, across every folder, results with breadcrumb; filter by tag and by folder.
features.reason: Finding a thing is the reason to have the list. SwiftData #Predicate on a normalised (diacritic- and case-folded) search key.

features.name: Total figure
features.description: Main screen shows one SbuStat: total quantity of items in the inventory (or in the open folder), closed by the full stop; value is a secondary line in inkMuted when values exist.
features.reason: Design system: one figure per screen. Count is always defined; value is optional data.

features.name: No item cap, everything free
features.description: Unlimited items, folders, photos, fields and exports; no trial, no account, no plan screen.
features.reason: 130 of 216 reviews: price, subscription, price hikes; 26 name the 100-item free cap.

features.name: Your data never held hostage
features.description: Data lives in SwiftData on the device; export of the whole inventory as CSV (one row per item, folder path column) and as a ZIP with CSV + photos, from Settings at any time; import from the same CSV.
features.reason: 19 reviews: data lost after an update, locked behind login, 'digital hostage taking', 'export within 3 days or lose it'.

features.name: Custom fields
features.description: Per-item fields from a user list: text, number, date, money; field templates reused across items (e.g. Numero di serie, Garanzia fino al).
features.reason: Sortly 'Custom fields & tags'; one review asks for purchase date and serial in exports.

features.name: Value and purchase data
features.description: Optional price per unit, purchase date, currency from Locale; folder and total value computed with Decimal and shown with .currency format.
features.reason: Home inventory for insurance is the main personal use (23 reviews from home users priced out).

features.name: Tags
features.description: Free tags with autocomplete, tag filter in search.
features.reason: Sortly 'Custom fields & tags'; 'Tags no longer available' review.

features.name: Find by label
features.description: Scan a barcode or QR already on an item or box (VisionKit DataScannerViewController) to open it or attach that code to it; manual code entry when the scanner is unsupported.
features.reason: Sortly 'Mobile barcode & QR code scanning'. Boundary with Sbu Scanner: only as an item label inside the inventory, never a generic reader, never shows URLs or content of unknown codes.

features.name: Low quantity reminder
features.description: Optional minimum per item; items at or below it get a word + SF Symbol badge ('Da ricomprare') and a filter; optional local notification, off by default.
features.reason: Sortly 'Low stock alerts', paywalled; one review asks for an alert below 3 qty.

features.name: Attachments
features.description: PDF receipts, manuals, warranties attached to an item from Files, QuickLook viewer.
features.reason: 'Please add attachments!' review: manuals and warranties.

features.name: Date reminders
features.description: Local notification on a date field (warranty end, expiry), off by default.

features.name: PDF report
features.description: Printable PDF of a folder or the whole inventory with photo, path, quantity, value, purchase date and custom fields, via ImageRenderer/UIGraphicsPDFRenderer and ShareLink.
features.reason: Insurance use; 'PDF export samples show almost no data' review.

features.name: iCloud sync
features.description: Opt-in in Settings, off by default (ADR-0008): SwiftData with CloudKit private database; photos as external storage assets.
features.reason: Sortly 'Automatic syncing across all devices'; without a server. 'Long standing sync error' review: sync never required to use the app.

features.name: iPad layout
features.description: NavigationSplitView: folders sidebar, items list, item detail; camera code works on iPad.
features.reason: 3 reviews: freezes on iPad, camera assumes iPhone, can't upload photos on iPad.

screens.name: Inventory
screens.purpose: Root folder on surface: one figure (total items, SbuStat + SbuFullStop), then folders and items (List .insetGrouped), search, add.
elements: inkMuted line: folders count, total value if any

screens.name: Folder
screens.purpose: Same layout one level down, breadcrumb title; figure is the folder's total.

screens.name: Item
screens.purpose: Detail: photo carousel, quantity stepper, path, fields.
elements: TabView photos, tap for full screen

screens.name: Edit item
screens.purpose: Form sheet to create or edit.

screens.name: Scan label
screens.purpose: DataScannerViewController for barcode/QR; opens the matching item or offers to attach the code.
elements: 'Nessun oggetto con questo codice' with Collega a un oggetto

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: SbuAppShell settings sheet: export, import, iCloud toggle, fields, licences.

flows.name: First item
steps: Take a photo or pick one

flows.name: Organize a move
steps: Stick the box's existing barcode/QR, scan it, Collega a 'Scatola 3'
Later: scan the box, folder opens with its contents

flows.name: Delete
steps: Swipe an item or folder > Elimina
Confirm (SbuButton .destructive), folder confirm states how many items go with it

fields.name: parent
fields.note: nil = root; nullify, delete cascades children after confirm

fields.name: searchKey
fields.note: folded name + notes + tags + field values, for #Predicate

data_model.storage: SwiftData in Application Support, CloudKit-compatible from day one (optionals or defaults on every property, no unique constraints, optional relationships) so the opt-in iCloud sync (ADR-0008) needs no migration. Totals computed with fetchCount and a pure aggregator type tested with Swift Testing. CSV writer/reader and ZIP writer (stored, no compression needed for HEIC) are pure types with tests; no third-party library.

monetization.price: Reviews quote $4.99/month in the past, now $24-49.99/month or $299-450/year for Advanced, $1,068-2,700/year for Ultra; repeated price hikes on renewal
monetization.notes: Account required to use the app; data stored on Sortly's servers. Pivoted from home users ('My Things') to businesses.

pains.pain: Price: subscription, repeated price hikes at renewal, home users priced out, charges after cancelling
pains.evidence: "$50/month or $300/year is a crazy price for a household app."

pains.pain: 100-item free cap discovered after entering items
pains.evidence: "only to find that there is a cap for the free account- it is 100 items"

pains.pain: Bugs, crashes, slowness, sync errors, broken after updates
pains.evidence: "It either doesn't save or looses data. It freezes the entire iPad."
pains.becomes: Local SwiftData, no sync needed to work; iPad layout (P2)

pains.pain: Home users abandoned: app turned business-only
pains.evidence: "too expensive for personal use where you're not recovering your cost"
pains.becomes: One thing for the home: places, photos, quantities; no pick lists, users, sales

pains.pain: Data lost, locked behind login or held hostage to force upgrade
pains.evidence: "Your current plan doesn't allow this feature. Please upgrade your plan." (on password reset)
pains.becomes: Your data never held hostage: on device, CSV and ZIP export always

pains.pain: Forced account, sign-up and cancellation problems
pains.evidence: "You download the app and it won't even let you create an account"

pains.pain: Photo orientation, photos only from in-app camera, can't upload on iPad
pains.evidence: "Photos have to be snapped from within app"
pains.becomes: Items with photos (PhotosPicker + camera, EXIF orientation)

pains.pain: No dark mode, hard-to-read new UI
pains.evidence: "the app is blinding when 99% of your other apps are using dark mode"

pains_note: 216 reviews 1-3 stars of Sortly, US and IT (research/paywall-pain:research/529353551/reviews.json), counted by keyword pass then skimmed; a review can count in more than one pain. Scanning complaints (barcode lookup finds no product, Bluetooth scanner paywalled) are business needs and stay out.

skipped.reason: Server-side and business-only; no accounts (CLAUDE.md). Sharing one folder read-only via iCloud (ADR-0009) is possible later, not v1.
No network; data stays on the device or in the user's iCloud.
No QR generator (boundary with Sbu Scanner); the user labels with codes already on boxes or any printed sticker.

skipped.feature: Generic code reader, product lookup by barcode
skipped.reason: Sbu Scanner's job, and lookup needs a network database.

skipped.feature: Pick lists, sales, stock movements, purchase orders, Bluetooth scanners, integrations (QuickBooks)
skipped.reason: Business inventory, out of the one thing for the home.
One figure per screen; a PDF report (P2) covers insurance.
Server-side in competitors; not needed to write a name.

system_frameworks.name: VisionKit
system_frameworks.use: DataScannerViewController for item labels (P1), isSupported check

system_frameworks.name: UserNotifications
system_frameworks.use: low quantity and date reminders, off by default

dependencies_note: Apple frameworks and SbuKit only. ZIP export uses stored entries (HEIC is already compressed), a writer of about 100 lines with CRC32 from zlib (libz is a system library).

review_risks.risk: New Sbu app while the 14/10 lot is in the Resolution Center; Inventory is listed as low risk in niche-crowding (leader 14k US, 144 IT ratings).
review_risks.mitigation: Submit only after Apple answers, one per week; review notes describe a multi-screen tool (folders, photos, search, export) with no overlap with the catalog.

review_risks.risk: Scanning barcodes in two Sbu apps.
review_risks.mitigation: Scanner is not reachable as a reader: it only opens or links inventory items, unknown codes are never shown as content or URLs; no QR generator. Stated in review notes.

review_risks.risk: Using 'Sortly' in name, subtitle or keywords.
review_risks.mitigation: Never; docs/factory.md forbids third-party app names in Store metadata.
NSCameraUsageDescription in IT/EN: photographing items and reading labels; PhotosPicker needs no permission.
'Prova con un esempio' adds a sample folder with items and our own photos, removable in one tap.

review_risks.risk: Copying Sortly's grid and red style.
review_risks.mitigation: Sbu design system, native List, own copy and icon.

decisions_needed: Main figure: total quantity of items (proposed, always defined) or total value (only when prices are entered).
iCloud sync in 1.0 or 1.1: CloudKit-ready model from day one either way; P2 proposed.
Label scanning in Inventory (P1, VisionKit) accepted as not overlapping Sbu Scanner, or v1 ships without scanning.
estimate_note: P0 about 6 days (model, folders, item form with photos, search, totals, CSV/ZIP export-import, tests); P1 +2 (fields, value, tags, label scan, low quantity); P2 +3-4 (attachments, reminders, PDF, iCloud, iPad).
